test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 13 March, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Apple II is an example of _______ Generation of computer.
solution:
The correct answer is **Fourth**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Apple II is an example of a Fourth-generation computer.
 
• **Fourth-generation computers (1972-present)** use microprocessors. This made them even smaller, faster, and more efficient.
 
• **Second Generation Computers (1950s-1960s):**
 
• Transistors were smaller, faster, more reliable, and produced less heat than vacuum tubes.
 
• The use of transistors led to a significant reduction in the size of computers, making them more compact and efficient.
 
• The Apple II, introduced in 1977, is considered a representative example of this generation.
 
• The second generation of computers was marked by the replacement of vacuum tubes with transistors.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• First-generation computers (1946-1958) were mainframe computers that used vacuum tubes as their primary components. They were large, expensive, and consumed a lot of power.
 
• Third-generation computers (1965-1971) used integrated circuits (ICs). This made them even smaller, faster, and more efficient.
